ipa_style: Broad phonemic IPA; /ɹ/ for consonantal R, /ɝ, ɚ/ for rhotic vowels; stress shown for multisyllabic words. No allophonic flapping or aspiration.
position_definition: Position of the selected target occurrence in the spoken whole word or phrase, not the spelling. Medial includes within-word clusters and compound boundaries. An entry may contain other target occurrences.
status: Starter vocabulary and broad IPA draft; SLP review recommended before clinical release.
notes: Each category has exactly 20 initial, 20 medial, and 20 final entries.
A few multiword labels and morphologically related words are included to preserve imageability. Word counts refer to flashcard entries.
Some words contain consonant clusters or additional target occurrences; this is not a singleton-only set.
IPA reflects one American pronunciation; regional variants exist, especially vowels and words such as orange, water, garage, and sandwich.
Image cues are suggestions, not guarantees that a child will name the intended word.

R.label: R
R.notes: Includes consonantal /ɹ/ and rhotic vowels /ɝ, ɚ/. Use target_variant to filter. This is not a balanced vocalic-R inventory.

Z.label: Z
Z.notes: Initial /z/ has limited common picture vocabulary. Some entries are less familiar or inflected forms of the same base word.
